ns2:course.label: Ornithology
ns2:course.description: (IB 361) Structure, function, ecology, behavior, and evolution of the birds of the world; laboratory devoted to anatomy and identification; and field studies devoted to identification and behavior of birds. Independent research project and two optional weekend field trips. 5 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Offered in alternate years. Prerequisite: IB 203; or consent of instructor.
